name: Nishizaki Asahi
source: Art teacher at Seishuu Academy. She works hard to prove her maturity. Short-tempered to others that call her childish. Old dorm mate and friend of Kaho when they were students at Shuukoukan Academy.
translation: 青修学园的美术教师。她努力证明自己已经成熟。有人说她孩子气时，她就会勃然大怒。她在秀光馆学园就读时曾与佳穗同住一个宿舍，也是佳穗的朋友。
